title: Sucesso do Cliente - CS Júnior / Pleno
description:
Na LAKS, somos uma assessoria de marketing e vendas, com mentalidade inovadora e em constante crescimento, impulsionada pela busca por excelência e resultados. Acreditamos que o sucesso e a satisfação de nossos clientes são os pilares fundamentais para o nosso crescimento e para a realização de nossos objetivos estratégicos. Valorizamos a transparência, a eficiência e o compromisso com a qualidade em todas as nossas operações.


Missão do Cargo

Garantir o relacionamento do cliente, zelando pelo seu sucesso e satisfação, com o objetivo primordial de diminuir o índice de retrabalho e aumentar as taxas de renovação. Em outras palavras, ser o guardião da experiência positiva do cliente com a LAKS.

Responsabilidades Principais

Como profissional de Sucesso do Cliente na LAKS, você será responsável por:

●      Gestão de Relacionamento: Gerenciar ativamente o relacionamento pós-venda, garantindo a satisfação e fidelização dos clientes, e colocando-se à inteira disposição para suas necessidades.

●      Onboarding Otimizado: Planejar e otimizar os processos de onboarding de novos clientes, assegurando uma transição suave e eficaz para a utilização de nossos serviços.

●      Acompanhamento Contínuo: Realizar o acompanhamento sistemático de todos os clientes, monitorando sua jornada e garantindo o alinhamento com seus objetivos.

●      Feedback e NPS: Coletar o Net Promoter Score (NPS) mensalmente para medir a satisfação do cliente e utilizar esses dados para identificar pontos de melhoria.

●      Engajamento Proativo: Manter o cliente engajado através de uma cadência de comunicação (mensagens e ligações mensais), fomentando o relacionamento e prevenindo o Churn.

●      Orientação e Suporte: Orientar cada cliente sobre as melhores práticas e passos a seguir para obter resultados máximos com nossos serviços.

●      Resolução de Problemas: Identificar proativamente as dificuldades e desafios enfrentados pelos clientes e apresentar soluções eficazes e ágeis.

●      Garantia de Requisitos: Assegurar que os requisitos e expectativas dos clientes estejam sendo atendidos em todas as etapas do relacionamento.

●      Upsell e Renovação: Promover ativamente oportunidades de upsell (expansão do MRR) e garantir a renovação dos contratos.

●      Aplicação do Conhecimento: Assegurar que o cliente coloque em prática os conhecimentos e estratégias fornecidas pela LAKS.

●      Gestão da Experiência: Ser o principal responsável pela experiência do consumidor com o produto/serviço, visando sua fidelização e o aumento do Lifetime Value (LTV).

●      Colaboração Interna: Participar ativamente de reuniões com a equipe para aprimorar processos, acompanhar resultados e compartilhar insights valiosos dos clientes.

●      Acesso a Treinamentos: Dar acesso ao treinamento comercial e outros recursos educacionais para os clientes LAKS.

●      Monitoramento de Qualidade: Acompanhar a qualidade e a execução dos \"bom dias semanais\" (semanalmente, seg/qua/sex) e garantir que eles sejam realizados.

Requisitos Técnicos

Para ter sucesso nesta função, esperamos que você tenha:

●      Formação superior completa ou em andamento em Administração, Marketing, Comunicação, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas.

●      Experiência comprovada em Customer Success, Atendimento ao Cliente, Relacionamento com Clientes ou Pós-Vendas.

●      Conhecimento e familiaridade com sistemas de CRM para gestão do ciclo de vida do cliente.

●      Habilidade para analisar dados e métricas relacionadas ao sucesso do cliente (NPS, Churn Rate, LTV, MRR).

●      Domínio do Pacote Office, com Excel intermediário para acompanhamento e elaboração de relatórios.

●      Conhecimento em estratégias de comunicação e engajamento via WhatsApp e outras plataformas.


Competência comportamentais

Buscamos um profissional com as seguintes características:

●      Foco Excepcional no Cliente: Paixão genuína por servir, entender as necessidades do cliente e garantir sua satisfação e sucesso.

●      Empatia e Escuta Ativa: Capacidade de se colocar no lugar do cliente, compreender suas dores e construir um relacionamento de confiança.

●      Habilidade de Comunicação: Clareza, objetividade e persuasão na interação com clientes, tanto verbalmente quanto por escrito, mantendo o \"coração quentinho\" através de uma comunicação eficaz.

●      Proatividade e Senso de Urgência: Iniciativa para antecipar problemas, buscar soluções e garantir o engajamento contínuo dos clientes.

●      Resolução de Problemas: Aptidão para identificar desafios, analisar situações complexas e propor soluções criativas e eficazes para os clientes.

●      Organização e Planejamento: Habilidade para gerenciar uma carteira de clientes, priorizar tarefas e cumprir prazos de forma eficiente.

●      Negociação e Persuasão: Capacidade de identificar oportunidades de upsell e conduzir negociações para renovações de contratos.

●      Trabalho em Equipe: Colaboração efetiva com as equipes de Vendas, Marketing e Operações para garantir a melhor experiência global para o cliente.


O que oferecemos

Na LAKS, valorizamos nossos colaboradores e oferecemos:

●      Salário competitivo e compatível com o mercado.

●      Benefícios (Wellhub – bem-estar e saúde, Vale Ifood Aniversário).

●      Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, colaborativo e desafiador.

●      Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e crescimento dentro da empresa.

title: SAP Consultant
description:
About the Role


The SAP MDG (Material Master Data) Consultant is responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting SAP MDG function for all types of master data, and its integration with S/4HANA and other applications across global enterprises. The role ensures data governance, master data quality, workflow enforcement and compliance with business rules. This key role focuses on providing technology solutions for business requirements, providing global design and localization as warranted, stabilizing and enhancing the existing solutions, resolving defects, production break-fixes, as well as providing recommendation regarding optimal business processes by leveraging SAP best practices. This person will collaborate with the Product Owner, Project managers, system architects and the business partners to understand key objectives and challenges, ensure successful outcomes, and provide the right direction in the dynamic business environment.



Responsibilities



  • Serve as the subject matter expert for solution development in the SAP MDG area
  • Design, configure, and implement SAP MDG solutions for domains such as Business Partner, Customer, Vendor, Material, and Finance.
  • Lead end-to-end MDG implementations, including requirements gathering, blueprinting, configuration, testing, and go-live support
  • Configure MDG data models, change request types, workflows, business rules, validations, and derivations
  • Integrate SAP MDG with ECC, S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to define data governance processes, roles, and policies
  • Support data migration, data cleansing, and data quality initiatives
  • Configure and support BRF+, Workflow (WS-BPEL/Flexible Workflow), DRF, and UI (Fiori/Web Dynpro)
  • Perform configuration of systems and manage transport as part of ITSM, Cloud ALM, and change management across the SAP landscape
  • Provide production support, issue resolution, and continuous improvement enhancements
  • Create functional and technical documentation, including design specs, test scripts, and user guides
  • Support user training and knowledge transfer activities to the managed service team.
  • Ensure compliance with data standards, audit requirements, and best practices
  • Perform Functional Unit testing, Product testing, System integration testing, cross functional testing, testing of SAP upgrades, Performance testing, etc.
  • Support UAT, provide user training and support change management and business enablement.
  • Manage and maintain overall solution architecture, scalability, and integrity.
  • Provides hands-on support to developers (e.g., resolving technical blockers and reviewing code)
  • Other job duties and projects as assigned.


Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of experience in SAP Master Data Governance


Required Skills



  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP MDG-BP, MDG-M, MDG-F, or MDG-S.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA integration and other SAAS and non-SAP systems.
  • Solid understanding of data governance frameworks and master data lifecycle
  • Experience configuring: Data Models & Change Request Types, BRF+ Rules, Workflow, Data Replication Framework (DRF)
  • Knowledge of Fiori apps and MDG UI customization
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data analysts, IT, and business stakeholders, to ensure seamless integration and alignment of MDG solutions.
  • Training and Support: Provide training and support to team members and end-users on MDG best practices and solutions.
  • Provide regular reports on system health and performance.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies and frameworks such as Kanban as well as use of tools like Jira and Service Now.
  • Facilitate work and resource estimation, track progress, provide escalations and status updates.


Preferred Skills



  • SAP MDG Certification

description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.


How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends


Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field

Knowledge:

Skills:

  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)


Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership

Equal Opportunity Employer

We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca.
Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.

Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes.
Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores.
Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.

), negociando cadernos técnicos e prazos de aprovação.

Legalização: Coordenar os processos de obtenção de alvarás e licenças, garantindo a conformidade de todas as unidades do grupo.

Autonomia e Proatividade: Perfil "dono do negócio", capaz de gerir múltiplos cronogramas e tomar decisões rápidas em cenários de obra.
Organização: Disciplina para gerenciar orçamentos e prazos de diferentes marcas ao mesmo tempo.

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us!
Job challenges:
- Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT;
- Monitor, and enforce KNOT's HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation;
- Monitor companyactivities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements;
- Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace;
- Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses;
- Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits;
- Participate in emergency response drills and simulations;
- Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures;
Requirements:
- Technical degree in Occupational Safety;
- Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry;
- Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested;
- Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs);
- Intermediate Excel skills;
- Desirable: Bachelor's degree;
- Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer:
- Food allowance;
- Transportation allowance without discount;
- Health and dental plan at no cost;
- Life insurance;
- Private pension;
- Profit-Sharing;
- Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
- Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
- Advanced English (spoken and written),
- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
- Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
- Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
- Hybrid working model,
- One day off on your birthday,
- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
- Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
- Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: Consultor(a) de investimentos associado(a)
description:
Se você já atua no mercado financeiro e procura a melhor estrutura para atender seus clientes sem conflito de interesses, com boas perspectivas de carreira e sendo bem remunerado, essa vaga é para você!
Somos uma consultoria de investimentos que atende famílias em busca do crescimento patrimonial e da preservação do legado. Atendemos clientes em todos os grandes bancos e corretoras do Brasil e também nos EUA. Nosso modelo de atuação é 100% FEE BASED sem conflito de interesses.
ALOCAÇÃO: Somos associados ao grupo Nord Investimentos garantindo que as melhores estratégias de alocação estarão à disposição dos seus clientes, ou seja, você terá relatórios e calls de investimento independentes e de alta qualidade.
INDEPENDÊNCIA: Trabalhamos com todos os bancos no Brasil e temos integração com 3 instituições americanas (Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers e Avenue), ou seja, onde quer que seu cliente esteja, você poderá atendê-lo.
EXPERIÊNCIA: Temos um time experiente e com metodologia proprietária que ajuda na conversão de leads (90%) e retenção de clientes (churn menor que 0,50% ao ano).
CARREIRA: Nosso programa de partnership garante que você tenha oportunidade de aumentar sua participação societária no nosso grupo empresarial na medida em que seus resultados e contribuições cresçam. Nossa empresa também possui uma corretora de seguros completa (Monte Bianco Insurance) e uma área com soluções Corporate que atende PJ com empréstimos, cambio, energia e antecipação de recebíveis. Ou seja, aqui você pode oferecer uma oferta completa de produtos e serviços para seus clientes.
Essa proposta de valor em conjunto com nossa metodologia exclusiva tem resultado em mais de 90% de taxa de conversão de leads em clientes.
Estamos em busca de profissionais experientes da área de investimentos para ampliar a equipe da Monte Bianco Multi-Family Office (MBM) no Rio de Janeiro. Este cargo demanda a realização de recomendações financeiras especializadas, gerenciamento de carteiras de investimento e interação contínua com clientes para entender suas necessidades e objetivos financeiros. As responsabilidades diárias incluem análise de tendências de mercado, identificação de oportunidades de investimento e fornecimento de um serviço ao cliente de alta qualidade.
Qualificações
Investimentos e Finanças: necessário ter experiência prévia em atender clientes no mercado financeiro.
Relacionamento: garantir que as necessidades dos clientes sejam compreendidas e atendidas de maneira eficaz.
Prospecção: captação ativa de novos leads e desenvolvimento da estratégias para conversão Caso o candidato não possua nenhuma das certificações exigidas (CEA/CFP/CNPI), será concedido um prazo de 6 meses para que consiga se certificar.

description:

Benefits we offer: - Food allowance; - Transportation allowance without discount; - Health and dental plan at no cost; - Life insurance; - Private pension; - Profit-Sharing; - Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.

Job Title:Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician
Location:Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required

Contract Type:CLTAbout LG Sonic: LG Sonicis a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.Position Summary:
The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

Strong problem-solving skills

Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.Why Join LG Sonic?At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.Application Process:If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:

Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.

description:

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Sua missão

  • Padronizar o processo de desmontagem na unidade de Lavras em conjunto com a empresa terceira.
  • Atuar na estruturação e desenvolvimento da filial.
  • Apoiar a implantação de processos e fluxos operacionais.

SOBRE NÓS!
Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.
Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.
E não para por aí!
A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.
Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.
O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!
A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas" .
E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.
Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos?
Se a sua resposta for sim, aqui é o seu lugar!

title: Psicólogo - Supervisor ABA
description:
Missão

Desenvolver, supervisionar e garantizar a eficácia dos padrões clínicos e das intervenções baseadas em Analise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) na Jano Saúde, promovendo a qualidade dos atendimentos, a formação da equipe clínica e a adesão às melhores práticas com base em evidências científicas. Atua também como facilitador da coordenação do cuidado e da integração com famílias, escolas e equipes interdisciplinares.

Atividades

Acolhida/contato inicial com o aprendiz, família, escola e equipe multidisciplinar

  • Realizar acolhimento inicial de famílias e indivíduos neuro divergentes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.
  • Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, assim como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas, para o delineamento da intervenção.
  • Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe multidisciplinar possam ter sobre a intervenção.

Avaliação comportamental e desenvolvimento do plano de tratamento individualizado (PTI)

  • Planejar e realizar avaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.
  • Planejar e realizar avaliações funcionais.
  • Redigir relatórios de avaliação e protocolos, programas ou procedimentos individualizados de ensino de habilidades, prevenção e redução de problemas de comportamento do aprendiz com base na função.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório a cada 4 meses.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida a cada 1 ano.
  • Definir carga horária e local de tratamento do cliente.

Intervenção

  • Confeccionar o plano de intervenção individualizado (PTI) do aprendiz.
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de materiais instrucionais (programas e descrição de procedimentos) e folhas de registro necessárias para a implementação da intervenção.
  • Supervisionar no mínimo 10% da carga horária de intervenção, distribuídas em horas de supervisão diretas e indiretas.
  • Avaliar o progresso dos comportamentos na intervenção a partir da análise dos dados sistematizados e/ou observação direta (na presença e na ausência do aprendiz).
  • Realizar relatórios de evolução mensal para plano de saúde quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar os planos de transição entre equipes, desligamento ou alta do aprendiz.
  • Redigir documentos como pautas e atas de reuniões realizadas com familiares e equipe.
  • Modificar ou descontinuar do serviço prestado, baseado na avaliação dos riscos e benefícios de continuar a intervenção ou substituí-la por práticas alternativas, estando a decisão formalizada em prontuário/ficha de atendimento do aprendiz.

Coordenação, monitoramento e treinamento

  • Avaliar e prover feedback do desempenho da equipe de intervenção comportamental e familiares na implementação dos procedimentos delineados para o aprendiz.
  • Realizar orientação e treino parental.
  • Coordenar, orientar e treinar a equipe de intervenção, os familiares, cuidadores e outras pessoas significativas, a implementar os programas e procedimentos delineados, na presença e na ausência do aprendiz.
  • Realizar comunicação e treinamento, quando necessário, da equipe de coordenação de cuidado.

Escolaridade / Formação

  • Ensino superior em psicologia, com carteira do conselho ativa.
  • Pós graduação completa em análise do comportamento aplicada ao TEA.
  • Ter obtido título de mestre ou doutor em análise do comportamento ou áreas associadas ao desenvolvimento atípico (diferencial).
  • Certificação em procedimento de gerenciamento de crises agressivas (diferencial).

Experiência Profissional

  • Experiência anterior como supervisor ABA acima de 1 ano.

title: Head of Legal
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets , requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. A structured business mindset and a holistic approach to the needs of a growing startup are essential, and these qualities will be assessed throughout the interview process.

  • Enable the company to scale effectively through strong legal foundations
  • Act as the legal backbone for strategic decisions , from operations to international expansion
  • Structure and support complex, cross-border deals and partnerships
  • Ensure robust governance, compliance, and risk management across all activities
  • Bridge legal across Science, Operations, Supply, Business Development and People
  • Strengthen investor confidence through clear and reliable legal frameworks
  • Manage external network of trusted legal advisors

Core working relationships

  • Directly reporting to the CFO.
  • Internal: Science & Operations Team, HR, Business Development, Leadership & Investors
  • External: Legal boutiques (contracts & commercial), Tax advisors, Governance specialists, Regulatory bodies

Context of the role:

  • You will join a lean and evolving legal function , with high ownership from day one
  • Legal demand is rapidly growing alongside company scale
  • Strong need to connect legal across international teams (Science, Carbon, BD)
  • The role has potential to evolve into VP Legal , depending on scope and impact

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the central legal hub across all company functions, both locally (Brazil) and internationally
  • Lead due diligence processes (legal and regulatory)
  • Structure, negotiate, and manage complex contracts , including:
    • Farmers, Mining partners, NDAs, Joint ventures, International commercial agreements, Corporate documentation (e.g. Investment agreements)
  • Own cross-border legal strategy and execution
  • Strengthen and improve corporate governance and entity structures (Brazil & international)
  • Work closely with tax advisors
  • Ensure compliance across multiple regulatory domains , including environmental, mining, agribusiness, and carbon markets
  • Support the People Team with labour and service provision requirement
  • Support investor relations from a legal standpoint
  • Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructure

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Law degree with active OAB registration (Brazil)
  • 8–15+ years of experience , ideally with strong exposure to environmental, operations or infrastructure-related sectors
  • Proven experience in:
    • Commercial and business law, ideally from a startup angle
    • Due diligence (legal & regulatory)
    • Complex contract structuring and negotiation
    • International contracts and cross-border operations
  • Strong background in business-oriented legal roles (e.g., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)
  • Solid experience with:
    • Corporate law and governance
    • Investor relations and strategic partnerships
  • Fluency in English , with experience working in international environments

Key Qualities

  • Business-oriented mindset : understands legal as a driver of growth
  • Highly relational : strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions
  • Strategic thinker : connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks
  • Pragmatic and solution-driven : balances risk with execution speed
  • High ownership : comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure
  • Strong institutional presence : capable of representing the company externally
  • Structured and integrative : able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains
  • Neutral and sound judgment , especially in complex or sensitive matters

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets
  • Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms
  • Exposure to governance and international structures
  • Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)
  • Business and legal experience in Germany
  • Speaks German
  • Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SP

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact : You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our compensation philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Equity to feel like an owner
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

  • Refeição no local sem desconto;

  • Frequentes processos de seleção interna proporcionando desenvolvimento e o crescimento dos nossos funcionários na empresa;
  • Parceria pioneira com o SESC com o espaço SESC + SAÚDE, oferecendo serviços gratuitos de odontologia e saúde da mulher (preventivo e mamografia) aos nossos funcionários.

SOBRE NÓS!

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos. Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento. E não para por aí! A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia. Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos. O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara! A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como “A marca mais amada do Rio” e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a “Marca preferida dos Cariocas”. E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos?
Se a sua resposta for sim, aqui é o seu lugar!

Você conhece o Club Med?

Temos quase 70 resorts, abertos no verão e no inverno, em 26 países. Oferecemos férias de alto padrão nas montanhas e à beira-mar. Nossos clientes procuram felicidade e liberdade.

Oferecemos a oportunidade de se desenvolver e evoluir muito rapidamente, fazendo parte de nossas equipes brilhantes. Você poderá viajar pelo mundo.

Seu ambiente de trabalho

Cada resort conta com vários restaurantes e bares — alguns voltados para eventos, outros mais intimistas — que oferecem nosso sistema Premium All Inclusive. De buffets ao serviço empratado, de experiências de show cooking a inúmeros eventos festivos, você terá muitas oportunidades para expressar seu know‑how e criatividade, enquanto se enriquece com todas as nossas facetas. Nossa oferta refinada se baseia em 5 pilares: criar experiências memoráveis, surpreender com diversos espaços gastronômicos conceituais, trabalhar pelo bem‑est. de todos (inclusive o seu), despertar emoções e sentidos por meio da ambientação, tudo em uma atmosfera descontraída e divertida.

Você é

  • Sociável: sabe se conectar com nossos hóspedes e criar uma relação de confiança.
  • Eficiente: sabe gerenciar prioridades e garantir um serviço pontual.
  • Atento: garante que cada hóspede receba um atendimento personalizado.

Você irá

  • Valorizar o serviço de restaurante criando uma relação personalizada com os clientes (qualidade na recepção e no atendimento no restaurante);

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Role Overview:
As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.
Core Responsibilities:
• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.
• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.
• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.
• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.
• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.
Qualifications & Skills:
• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.
• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X)
• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).
• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.
• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company's internal knowledge base.
• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Brazil senior condition intelligence (ci & pm)
description:
Company Description
Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world's largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.
Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.
Role Description
As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.
In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo's advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.
With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo's reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.
Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.
Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.
Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.
Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.
Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.
Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.
Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.
Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.
Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.
Qualifications
Experience – Minimum of five (5) years' experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.
Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.
Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.
Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.
Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.
Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

description:
This role is for the person who:
Wants to help founders of e Commerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials.
Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on.
Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged. The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience.
To support our continued growth, this is an active position we're currently recruiting for.
About Up Counting
We're a fully remote, tech-powered firm helping e Commerce and digital-first businesses scale with confidence.
Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus.
We use smart systems and automation to deliver high-quality, efficient work across every department.
We prioritize a respectful, collaborative environment where people feel supported and have space for life outside of work.
We trust our team to lead with ownership and care — autonomy is part of our DNA.
What You'll Be Doing
Team Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of Accountants to deliver accurate, timely, high-quality work.
Full-Cycle Accounting Oversight: Review reconciliations, financial reports, and month-end close deliverables across multiple client files.
Operational Excellence: Ensure Up Counting's accounting processes are followed consistently and improve them where needed.
Client Support & Communication: Help clients understand their numbers, communicate insights clearly, and ensure smooth financial operations.
System & Process Optimization: Identify automation opportunities and contribute to scalable, efficient workflows alongside Controllers and senior leadership.
What You Bring
5+ years of experience in accounting management, ideally within a firm or multi-client environment.
High proficiency in Quick Books Online and/or Xero (Net Suite is a bonus).
Excellent communication and leadership skills — you elevate the people around you.
Strong technical foundation across full-cycle accounting, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
Comfortable using automation tools and improving processes.
FP& A or financial modeling experience is an asset.
A calm, structured leadership style — you bring clarity without micromanagement.
Perks & Culture
Because great work deserves a great place to do it.
Fully Remote + Async
Work flexibly from anywhere. During your first six months, you'll align closely with EST hours (9am–5pm) to onboard smoothly, then transition to 70% overlap.
Work from Anywhere
We care about outcomes, not location.
Paid Time Off
Enjoy paid time off, Me Days, Stat Holidays in your region, and our year-end company office closure.
Grow With Us
We promote from within based on performance, leadership, reliability, and impact.
Continuous Learning
We invest in your development through certifications, internal training, and ongoing learning.
Fair and Market-Aligned Compensation
Competitive pay matched to your experience and local market.
Your Journey at Up Counting
Your First Week
Meet the People Team and Accounting leadership, onboard into our systems, connect with your direct reports, and understand our workflows across tools, teams, and time zones.
Month 1
You'll be managing client files, team rhythms, and weekly deliverables. You'll be leading your team through core processes, learning the review system end-to-end, and begin shaping how we operate.
In 3 Months
You'll fully own your portfolio of accountants and clients—setting priorities, supporting performance, ensuring high-quality delivery, and improving workflows. You'll be a go-to leader with autonomy and clarity.
Curious About Our Values & Culture?
They're built around excellence, autonomy, respect, and curiosity. Learn more on our Careers Page.
How We Hire
Our process is transparent, straightforward, and human:
Apply via Typeform: Short questions + a brief video.
Introductory Call: A short conversation with our People Team to align expectations.
Scenario-Based Assessment + Technical Review: A strategic exercise reviewed by our senior finance team.
Final Interview: A culture and alignment conversation with leadership.
Offer: If it's a mutual fit, we move quickly — great partnerships shouldn't wait.
No cover letter needed, just tell us what drew you to Up Counting. Every application is reviewed by our People team — we don't use AI to screen or assess candidates. Thoughtful hiring matters to us.

title: Software engineer iii
description:

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Pré-requisitos: Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.
Diferencial: Certificação CFP, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.
Você terá: Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa departnershipestruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.
