title: Professor de espanhol
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.
Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.
Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.
Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.
Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.
Necessário: Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.
O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.
Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.
Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.
Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.
Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.
Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.
QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.
Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.
Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Engenheiro de dados - júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.
Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que unetecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitaispara solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras.
Agora comoparte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.
Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas.
Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.
Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgásconfiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.
Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantirambientes mais diversos e inclusivos.
Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura demulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.
Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks.
Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico.
Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.
Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines; Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados; Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico; Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises; Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing; Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões; Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting; Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance; Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados; Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados; Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.
Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics); Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks); Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (Data Frames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível); Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas); Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos; Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos); Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza; Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.
Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento).
Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança).
Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados).
Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure Dev Ops/Git Hub Actions).
Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas).
Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos).
Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards).
Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).
Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Gerente De Aterro Sanitário | Biogás
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1o de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar a operação de biogás e biometano, desde o campo de gás até a entrega do produto para o parceiro terceirizado.
  • Gerir times de campo e escritório, incluindo operação 24 horas da planta.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Aterro, Chorume e Logística.
  • Garantir a performance operacional, segurança, continuidade e eficiência da planta.
  • Desenvolver e executar o plano de crescimento do negócio de biogás, apoiando o aumento de receita.
  • Atuar como peça-chave na estratégia de expansão do grupo no setor de resíduos, com potencial de participação em novos projetos e ativos do Regenera.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a evolução da operação, considerando a mudança tecnológica do setor (de geração de energia para purificação de biogás e produção de biometano).
  • Conduzir análises de viabilidade técnica e econômica para expansão de capacidade, purificação para biometano ou ampliação da geração de energia.
  • Profissional com experiência comprovada em gás combustível de fonte renovável e Unidade de disposição final de resíduos sólidos, com atuação direta na gestão, monitoramento e análise de indicadores operacionais e ambientais do sistema de extração e aproveitamento energético do gás gerado por digestão anaeróbia.
  • Sólida vivência em sítios de destinação final ambientalmente controlados, incluindo controle de eficiência de captação, monitoramento de vazão, pressão, teor de metano (CH4), oxigênio (O2) e demais parâmetros críticos de desempenho.
  • Experiência na operação e manutenção da Unidade de Captação e Queima, com acompanhamento de KPIs como disponibilidade do sistema,controle de emissões e performance de flares.

title: Operations Assistant - Rezeption & Buchhaltung
description:
Über Digital Studio Rio

Digital Studio Rio unterstützt gastorientierte Betriebe mit modernen, digitalen Prozessen, klarer Kommunikation und verlässlichen Abläufen. Wir arbeiten serviceorientiert, pragmatisch und strukturiert – mit dem Ziel, dass im Hintergrund alles sauber funktioniert und Gäste sowie Teams sich auf reibungslose Prozesse verlassen können.Deine Mission

Du unterstützt unser Team in Rio in einer zentralen Backend-Rolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Rezeption, Gästeservice und Buchhaltung.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt darauf, dass Buchungen, Folios, Zahlungen, Rückerstattungen und backendseitige Abläufe korrekt und nachvollziehbar bearbeitet werden.

Gleichzeitig bist du in der Lage, bei Bedarf auch operativ zu unterstützen und als Backup für die Rezeption bzw. Gästekommunikation einzuspringen.

Deine Aufgaben
  • Bearbeitung und Prüfung von Folios, Buchungsdaten und Zahlungsinformationen im Backend
  • Kontrolle, ob backendseitig alle Vorgänge rund um Buchungen korrekt angelegt und verarbeitet sind
  • Bearbeitung von Rückerstattungen, Gutschriften und ähnlichen Zahlungsvorgängen
  • Abstimmung zwischen Rezeption / Gästeservice und Buchhaltung
  • Klärung von Unstimmigkeiten bei Zahlungen, Buchungen oder Abrechnungen
  • Pflege und strukturierte Dokumentation von Abläufen, Informationen und internen Standards
  • Unterstützung bei administrativen Aufgaben rund um Buchungen und Gästeprozesse
  • Bei Bedarf Backup-Unterstützung für die Rezeption, z. B. bei Gästefragen oder operativen Engpässen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem bestehenden Team in Rio
Das bringst du mit
  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B1-Niveau, schriftlich und mündlich
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
  • Gutes Verständnis für administrative und backendseitige Abläufe
  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools, Systemen und standardisierten Prozessen
  • Fähigkeit, sauber, konzentriert und lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten
  • Bereitschaft, sich in neue Systeme und Abläufe einzuarbeiten
  • Teamfähigkeit und klare Kommunikation
Große Vorteile für diese Rolle
  • Erfahrung in Buchhaltung, vorbereitender Buchhaltung oder Abrechnung
  • Verständnis für die Schnittstelle zwischen operativem Betrieb und Finance/Buchhaltung
  • Erfahrung mit Rückerstattungen, Zahlungsabgleichen oder Buchungskontrolle
  • Erfahrung in Hotellerie, Rezeption, Reservierung oder Gästeservice
  • Kenntnisse in DATEV sind ideal, aber keine Voraussetzung
  • Wichtig ist vor allem die Bereitschaft, sich strukturiert einzuarbeiten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen
Rahmenbedingungen
  • Remote-Position in Brasilien
  • Idealerweise in Rio de Janeiro
  • Vollzeit, Teilzeit nach Absprache möglich
  • Start: so bald wie möglich
Bewerbung

Bitte bewirb dich direkt über LinkedIn mit:

  • deinem Lebenslauf auf Deutsch
  • einem kurzen Satz, warum du gut zu dieser Rolle passt

Bitte beantworte außerdem auf Deutsch diese 3 Fragen:

  • Wo wohnst du aktuell?
  • Wann kannst du anfangen?
  • Ein Gast schreibt:
  • "Wir kommen heute später an. Können wir trotzdem einchecken?"
  • Was antwortest du?

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia's headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Medical Science Liaison (MSL) — AI Training

About The Role: We’re looking for experienced Medical Science Liaisons and clinical communications professionals to help build and validate AI systems trained on biomedical and life‑science content. Your scientific expertise will directly shape how AI understands, interprets, and communicates complex medical information—making a real impact on the future of healthcare AI.

This is a remote, flexible contractor role designed for working professionals who want to contribute their domain expertise to cutting‑edge AI research.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week
What You’ll Do
  • Review and evaluate AI‑generated medical and clinical content for scientific accuracy, clarity, and appropriate context.
  • Validate how AI systems interpret clinical trial data, medical literature, and regulatory materials.
  • Develop and assess scientific communication outputs tailored to healthcare professional audiences.
  • Identify errors, gaps, or misleading language in AI‑generated biomedical content.
  • Provide structured expert feedback to improve AI model quality and scientific integrity.
  • Work independently and asynchronously on your own schedule.
Who You Are
  • Background in medical affairs, clinical research, or scientific communications.
  • Proven experience engaging healthcare professionals (HCPs) in a field‑based or externally facing role.
  • Strong ability to interpret clinical data, peer‑reviewed publications, and regulatory documents.
  • Clear, precise written communication skills.
  • Detail‑oriented with a commitment to scientific accuracy.
  • Prior experience as an MSL, clinical educator, or scientific advisor strongly preferred.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with data annotation, content evaluation, or AI quality review workflows.
  • Familiarity with medical information systems or evidence synthesis.
  • Background in pharmacology, oncology, rare disease, or other therapeutic areas.
Why Join Us
  • Work on cutting‑edge AI projects at the intersection of life science and artificial intelligence.
  • Fully remote and flexible—work on your own schedule.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration.
  • Contribute to meaningful work that improves how AI handles critical medical information.
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Canonical is building a new generation of Ubuntu‑based container images to simplify open‑source application deployment across the world. These container images will be free to use with long‑term security commitments, and engineered for performance, security and usability. As with Ubuntu, we will work in the open and welcome community participation.

In this role, you’ll be developing the tools and technology for building and maintaining this new generation of container images. You’ll be working with multiple teams, both inside and outside Canonical, to ensure we deliver container images with the highest quality whilst maintaining a seamless Ubuntu user experience. You will also be highly involved in the implementation and maintenance of the Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery automation around these container images, for which you are expected to demonstrate deep insights into container‑based DevOps.

You will be contributing to fast‑moving products like Rocks (OCI images) and Chisel, and thus have the chance to help steer and consolidate this new team. You’ll gain experience with numerous container technologies and participate in exciting and exploratory tasks, where your feedback will be critical for the decision‑making process. As an engineer, your seniority will be based on your software development background and ability to lead junior team members.

Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical. This is an exciting opportunity for experienced software engineers looking for a place to leave their mark, who are passionate about shaping an open source product with the highest quality, with and for the community!

Location

EMEA

  • Build robust, scalable, leading‑edge container images
  • Work on automated Ci/CD processes for building, testing and publishing our container images
  • Write tools and tests for assessing security compliance and cloud‑native compatibility
  • Work in Go to deliver new functionalities to our container‑building tools
  • Participate in strong engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Provide technical feedback for the team’s decision‑making process
  • Engage with the open‑source community as a subject‑matter expert
  • Grow our knowledge base and write documentation
  • Work in a collaborative, agile and globally distributed environment
  • Mentor and help hiring
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events

Qualifications

  • You are a team player and have experience in collaborative development
  • You have worked with CI/CD systems (e.g. Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Concourse CI, etc.)
  • You have a track record of delivering timely, high‑quality software
  • You have experience with container images and containerised operations
  • You master at least one container management/orchestration tool (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • You have significant experience with Go
  • You are experienced with Linux systems administration and package management
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills to convey technical concepts
  • You bring clarity to technical and engineering discussions
  • You are someone who strongly believes that sharing is caring, and knowledge is power
  • Your skills range from those of a Graduate to a mid‑senior Software Engineer
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree

Benefits

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence — in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Oowlish, one of Latin America’s rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team. As a valued member, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions in a nurturing work environment recognized by our Great Place to Work certification. We offer remote work to support a healthy work‑life balance and opportunities for professional development, growth, and international impact.

About the Role

We are hiring a Data Scientist to transform data into actionable insights that inform product, operational, and business decisions. You will work closely with cross‑functional teams to analyse complex datasets, build predictive models, and develop data‑driven solutions that create measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities
  • Build and validate statistical, predictive, or machine learning models
  • Design experiments and evaluate results to support business decisions
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to define data needs
  • Translate analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations
  • Create documentation and visualisations to communicate results effectively
  • Continuously improve data models, methodologies and workflows

Must‑Have Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Science or applied analytics roles
  • Strong proficiency in Python and common data science libraries (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit‑learn, etc.)
  • Solid understanding of statistics, probability and data modelling
  • Experience working with SQL and relational databases
  • Ability to communicate complex insights clearly to non‑technical audiences

Nice to Have

  • Experience with machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.)
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure)
  • Experience with experimentation frameworks (A/B testing)
  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.)
  • Background in startup or fast‑paced environments

Benefits & Perks

  • Home office setup
  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Career plans for extensive growth within the company
  • International projects
  • Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational)
  • Oowlish Fitness with Total Pass
  • Games and competitions

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analysing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgement. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:
A Eneva emRio de Janeiro / RJ quer você no time! #VemSerEneva

Se você quer atuar comoEngenheiro(a) de Instrumentação e Controle temos um novo desafio para você:

Missão:

Atuar na disciplina de Instrumentação, Controle e Automação em projetos de usinas termelétricas, garantindo a qualidade técnica das entregas, a conformidade com normas nacionais/internacionais e requisitos da ENEVA.

Responsabilidades:

Realizar alinhamento técnico com os demais especialistas de outras disciplinas técnicas do projeto e com a coordenação técnica e gestão de Engenharia.

Desenvolver, revisar e/ou comentar/aprovar documentos de engenharia de instrumentação e controle, como diagramas de malha (loopdiagrams), listas de instrumentos, especificações técnicas de instrumentos e sistemas de controle, plantas de instrumentação etc.

Desenvolver, revisar e/ou comentar/aprovar especificações técnicas de instrumentos (pressão, temperatura, vazão, nível, etc.) e sistemas de controle distribuído (DCS), PLCs, sistemas de malha de segurança (SIS) e sistemas de malha fechada.

Acompanhar projetos de fornecedores e revisar/aprovar documentação técnica de pacotes de instrumentação, controle e automação.

Participar de reuniões técnicas com fornecedores, empresas subcontratadas de engenharia e demais disciplinas técnicas internas e/ou externas.

Interagir com outras disciplinas técnicas da engenharia (mecânica, processos, civil, elétrica etc.) para garantir a compatibilização do projeto.

Acompanhar testes de aceitação em fábrica (FAT) de sistemas de controle e instrumentos.

Assegurar conformidade com normas técnicas aplicáveis (ex: ABNT, IEC, ISA, NR-10, NR-12, etc.).

Elaborar estimativas de engenharia e apoiar desenvolvimento de estudos técnicos na área instrumentação e controle.

Avaliação técnica de propostas de fornecedores e equalização técnica de pacotes e equipamentos elétricos.

Fornecer suporte técnico durante as fases de construção, comissionamento, partida e operação da planta.

Conduzir e apoiar atividades de responsabilidade técnica relacionada à disciplina de I&C sempre que necessário.

Elaborar escopos de contratos, fazendo interface com consultores, fabricantes e fornecedores.

Acompanhar a contratação de serviços e aquisição de equipamentos/materiais, provendo o suporte necessário.

Zelar para que todos projetos e atividades sejam realizadas de forma segura, dentro das normas e regulamentos.

Desenvolver e revisar documentação técnica e procedimentos dentro do âmbito das responsabilidades da engenharia e/ou conforme orientação da gerência e coordenação.

Desenvolver modalidades de EPC, EPCM e Engenharia no segmento de energia e óleo e gás.

Desenvolver especificações e implantação de arquitetura de sistemas.

Desenvolver estratégias de controle, diagramas lógicos e integração de equipamentos mecânicos e elétricos.

Desenvolver especificações e análise técnica de instrumentos, válvulas de controle e segurança, analisadores e sistemas de detecção de fogo e gás.

Avaliar malhas de segurança (SIL) e análise de riscos de risco de processo (HAZOP).

Desenvolver sintonia de malhas de controle de processo.

Performar suas atividades de acordo com as normas da empresa, de segurança, de saúde, de higiene e da segurança do trabalho.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Superior completo em Engenharia, preferencialmente em Engenharia de Controle e Automação, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de usinas termelétricas ou plantas industriais de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de controle distribuído (DCS), PLCs, sistemas de segurança (SIS) e redes industriais.
  • Familiaridade com instrumentos de medição e controle aplicados a processos de geração de energia.
  • Desejável conhecimento em ferramentas de engenharia como SPI(SmartPlant Instrumentation), AutoCAD, entre outros.
  • Experiência com normas IEC, ISA, NR-10, NR-12, entre outras aplicáveis.
  • Inglês nível avançado a fluente.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Local de Trabalho:

Rio de Janeiro - RJ

title: Technical Solutions Architect
description:
Associate Solutions Architect – TestBox

Remote — Must be based in Rio de Janeiro or Niterói

$36,000 USD / year + equity & benefits

About TestBox

TestBox was founded with a bold mission : to fundamentally transform how software is bought and sold. We're building an innovative platform that empowers buyers with transparent, interactive software experiences, while equipping sellers with powerful tools to deliver exceptional buying and onboarding journeys. Our core technologies—synthetic data, intelligent orchestration, and our unique product graph—help teams achieve faster implementations, clearer insights, and increase trust with their customers.

At TestBox, we're not just improving demos; we're building the next generation infrastructure for software transactions, creating seamless experiences from initial interest to successful onboarding and beyond.

We're a fast-growing startup built by a team that values experimentation, velocity, and customer impact. We're backed by world-class investors and are building a platform that's disrupting the traditional B2B sales motion.

Role Overview

As a Solutions Architect at TestBox, you'll be at the heart of our customer experience—designing, building, and delivering high-impact demo and POC environments that drive sales success for our customers.

You’ll lead technical delivery, participate in agile rituals like standups and retros, and act as a trusted consultant to help customers design stories that resonate. You’ll also be expected to innovate and move fast—this isn't a role for someone looking to just “follow the playbook.”

To succeed here, you’ll need to be curious, flexible, and scrappy. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams, and you’ll use AI tools (including our own) daily to boost your productivity, generate data, and solve complex problems creatively.

Key Responsibilities

Project Ownership & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end implementation of customer demo and POC environments—from kickoff through delivery.
  • Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and retros; communicate blockers and drive timelines forward.
  • Collaborate across customer engineering, solutions, and product teams to ensure smooth handoffs and clear technical execution.

Customer Storytelling & Consulting

  • Help customers craft compelling demo narratives grounded in real-world buyer personas, workflows, and industry context.
  • Design fictional yet realistic companies and user journeys to simulate how the product solves specific problems.
  • Advise on best practices for demo structure, content pacing, and emotional resonance.

Environment Implementation

  • Configure CRM, support, or comms tools with customized fields, workflows, and industry templates.
  • Simulate real user behavior using automation, time-based triggers, and behavioral scripting. (We integrate AI-powered interactions where relevant to enhance realism)

AI-Driven Efficiency

  • Leverage AI tools (including LLMs like OpenAI and Anthropic, automation platforms) to speed up data generation, ticket writing, and documentation.
  • Continuously explore ways to innovate and disrupt traditional workflows using AI—TestBox is built on this mindset.

Documentation & Ticket Writing

  • Create detailed technical tickets and documentation to support repeatable environment setup and engineering handoffs.
  • Maintain internal knowledge resources for templates, industry scenarios, and technical edge cases.

Who You Are

  • You're fluent in english.
  • You're resourceful, autonomous, and outcomes-driven —comfortable leading projects with limited structure.
  • You think like a builder, act like an owner, and communicate like a product manager.
  • You thrive in startups : ambiguity excites you, pivots don't scare you, and you prioritize speed over perfection.
  • You believe AI is a power tool , not a novelty—and you're already using it to make your work better and faster.
  • You're comfortable translating between customer needs and technical systems, and enjoy being at the intersection of product, engineering, and sales.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3–5 years in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, Implementation, or similar technical consulting roles.
  • Ability to write and manage technical tickets and documentation for delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, and data formats like CSV and JSON.
  • Experience working in agile environments (standups, retros, ticket grooming, etc.).
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, text‑to‑speech engines, automation platforms) to drive efficiency, draft technical documentation, create demo content, or solve complex problems.
  • Bonus : Familiarity with synthetic data or interactive storytelling in demos. Completion of AI‑focused courses, certifications, or hands‑on projects.

Why Join TestBox

  • Shape the future of how software is bought and sold.
  • Build with a team that values autonomy, curiosity, and experimentation.
  • Use AI every day—not as a gimmick, but as a core productivity engine.
  • Make a direct impact in a high-growth startup redefining the demo experience.

Benefits

  • Generous equity package for meaningful ownership
  • Prioritization of your professional growth, with dedicated career development support
  • Flexible, unlimited PTO with a minimum expectation for recharge
  • Mental Health benefits
  • Fitness allowances
  • Learning allowances
  • Remote and office setup allowances to ensure productive and comfortable working environments

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.
The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.
Location: This is a Globally remote role
What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.
Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
What we offer you
Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.
  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum

  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Additional Information

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Associate director - Flights Marketing

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world.   • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights

  • Partner closely with various business functions, especially Marketing Accommodation, Flights product and flights supply, to identify opportunities, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using different techniques and tools such as SQL or Tableau to drive meaningful initiatives
  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness of business initiatives, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Communicate complex findings, performance updates, and strategic recommendations clearly and concisely to key stakeholders, including senior management
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of analysts and managers; participate in hiring and onboarding new team members.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Extensive Experience: 10+ years in Data Analyst position or otherwise in projects involving big data — preferably in the tech, e-commerce, or digital marketing industry. Experience in articulating strategic issues and negotiating with C-level executives – experience in leading strategy consulting projects
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Data-Driven Approach: Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze data, translate data into actionable insights, and generate impactful recommendations. You really need to love data for this role!
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL
  • Strong Communication Skills: Exceptional writing and verbal communication abilities, with proficiency in creating impactful and visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (especially Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
  • People management experience: including hiring, coaching, and developing team members
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership and a get-thing-done attitude.

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in the online travel or e-commerce industry
  • Experience in flights industry
  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

$45,000-$55,000

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.
Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.
Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.
“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.
Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.
Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.

Ele garante a excelência na execução dos serviços, a conformidade com as regulamentações, a otimização dos recursos e o desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, atuando como um pilar fundamental para a satisfação do cliente e a qualidade do serviço.

  • Gestão Operacional e Conformidade: Assegurar a implementação e a manutenção contínua dos processos definidos no Plano de Gerenciamento de Tecnologias em Saúde (PGTS) da unidade, utilizando os sistemas e ferramentas designados. Garantir a total conformidade das operações e documentações com a legislação vigente, normas técnicas (ex: NBR IEC 60601, ISO/IEC 17025 quando aplicável) e regulamentações (ANVISA, INMETRO). Revisar e garantir a organização e controle de todos os documentos relacionados aos processos no sistema de gestão (ex: DOO), assegurando sua rastreabilidade e fácil acesso. Preparar e organizar a documentação e processos referentes à acreditação hospitalar da unidade, montando apresentações para auditorias e liderando o processo para o sucesso da certificação.
  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipe: Supervisionar e orientar diariamente as atividades dos técnicos de engenharia clínica, garantindo a qualidade e eficiência na execução dos serviços de manutenção, calibração e ensaios. Acompanhar a performance individual e da equipe, provendo feedback construtivo e participando ativamente do desenvolvimento técnico dos colaboradores. Garantir a replicação e adesão da equipe aos treinamentos ministrados pela empresa, bem como promover o compartilhamento de conhecimento técnico com a equipe e com o corpo assistencial do cliente.
  • Gestão da Manutenção e Otimização do Parque Tecnológico: Garantir a resolutividade das solicitações de manutenção corretiva, supervisionando o diagnóstico, a cotação de peças/acessórios e a proposição de soluções eficazes. Supervisionar e acompanhar a execução da manutenção planejada (preventiva e preditiva) dos equipamentos, assegurando o cumprimento dos cronogramas e a emissão dos laudos e certificados. Assegurar o correto preenchimento e registro de todas as atividades no sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), desde a abertura da solicitação até a avaliação do serviço prestado. Elaborar pareceres técnicos e laudos de obsolescência de equipamentos, baseando-se no histórico e normativas, para subsidiar a avaliação do parque tecnológico do cliente.
  • Gestão de Fornecedores e Contratos: Supervisionar os serviços realizados por terceiros e a execução de contratos dentro da unidade, por meio da análise das ordens de serviço externas. Avaliar o custo-benefício de contratos e serviços avulsos de terceiros, propondo otimizações ou alternativas. Relacionar e controlar pedidos de materiais, acessórios e peças de reposição para garantir a eficiência e a continuidade do funcionamento dos Equipamentos Médico-Hospitalares (EMH), gerenciando o estoque no SGM.
  • Análise de Dados e Relatórios: Confeccionar relatórios técnicos detalhados de manutenções corretivas, preventivas, calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica. Realizar análises críticas para apresentar ao cliente o status dos equipamentos, sugerindo soluções técnicas e economicamente viáveis para otimizar a gestão do parque tecnológico. Manter o coordenador imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e desafios, buscando soluções e alinhando estratégias em reuniões e contatos diários.
  • Relacionamento com o Cliente e Expansão de Serviço: Atuar como ponto de contato técnico principal com a equipe e gestão do hospital cliente para assuntos relacionados à engenharia clínica. Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações, conforme a necessidade do cliente, com o objetivo de ampliar o escopo de serviços e soluções oferecidas.
  • Gestão de Ativos e Recursos: Zelar pela conservação e organização de todos os equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, solicitando reposição quando necessário. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo, delegadas pelo coordenador de engenharia clínica ou superior imediato.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Realizar a aferição da pressão de rede de distribuição de água e medidores;
  • Realizar demais atividades relacionadas a serviços de instalação/reparo e operação de água.

description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi Case

CEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

title: Vice President, Business Development
description:
Job Description

The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

What You Will Do:

  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector.
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management.
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility.
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action.
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning.
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate.
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required.
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred.
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector.
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required.
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required.
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS.
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios.
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility.
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes.

Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times. ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.
